entities.name: Caterans
entities.description: A guild of professional assassins, mercenaries, thieves and horrors roaming the back alleys of Mercadia City, killing or terrorizing for a price.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: City on Mercadia whose marketplace the Caterans haunt.

entities.name: Cateran
entities.description: A dementia summoner of Otaria who may be the originator of the caterans of Mercadia.

relations.note: They roam its marketplace back alleys.
relations.quote: that roam the back alleys of the marketplace of Mercadia City
